name: repo-statistik
description: Keeps the view and clone statistics of your GitHub repos permanently (GitHub itself shows only 14 days): a weekly GitHub Action stores the numbers in your own repo as a table and chart. Lets you see whether your tools get used without building a heartbeat or telemetry into them. The skill sets it up for your repos and reads the numbers back to you on request. German and English. Made by NetBoosting (https://netboosting.de).
